_comment: LB-1 — storage depth per (instrument, timeframe), expressed in DURATION (calendar), NOT in a bar count. Sized by the horizon of usefulness of each timeframe: fast units show NOW with precision, slow units show FAR. Duration grammar: <n><unit>, unit in d (day) | w (week) | mo (month) | y (year). Resolved to a target candle count via a trading-hours-aware conversion in src/intelligence/lookback_config.py. Per-instrument overrides go under instruments.<SYMBOL>; anything omitted there falls back to default. Adjustable without touching code. M1 is gated separately by the LB1_ENABLE_M1 env flag (default off).
_nw7_note: XAUUSD.M15 deepened to 24 months so candles.db can hold the ~12–24 monthly release windows + reference days the publication measures replay (NW-7). One-time backfill (~11 Twelve Data requests); the detection window is unchanged. This key is documentation only — the loader reads 'default' and 'instruments' exclusively.
